name: us021b-retired-disable-record
description: 034 [US3, FR-005, SC-004]: a checkout still carrying the retired operator disable record is REFUSED, identically in both ports. Until 034 this fixture's `hooks.disabled` key was accepted and honoured by a dispatch guard that exited 0 silently; the key is now outside config.local.yml's accepted set, so the run is refused with exit 4 and the schema's pre-existing unknown-key message naming both the key and the file. Nothing was added to produce that refusal — the point of the scenario is that the two ports agree on it byte for byte, which a per-port unit test cannot establish and which this project has previously substituted one for.
